name: gate-says-no
title: The gates hold, even against the model
kicker: How it was built · When the gate says no
html:
The gates hold, even against the model

Blocked

The protect-gate hook stopped the model reading the gate’s own event log. It didn’t try another way.

Human’s switch

Refactor mode, the only time src/main may change with no new red, is switched on by the person, never the model.

Redone

An edit made outside Claude Code’s edit tool was redone through it, so the log records every change.

The model doesn’t have to be trustworthy for the process to be.
say: Three moments from this work. The protect-gate hook blocked the model from reading its own event log; it didn't retry. Refactor mode is the human's switch, never the model's. And an edit made outside Claude Code's edit tool was redone through it, so the log saw it.
